reader.requirement: At 85 the integer of an absolute NEXT GROUP clause of a body group (control heading, detail, control footing) must lie between the FIRST DETAIL and FOOTING integers inclusive; the compiler must refuse one outside that range. The witness covers both legal bounds on detail groups only.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 adds the §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR1 check (NEXT GROUP needs a LINE NUMBER clause in the group); the presentation-rule range checks after it take no edition branch
DialectLevel < 2002: the 85-only three-significant-digit limit on integer-1/integer-2 (§1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR2), checked before the range checks

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectLevel/Year in BindNextGroupClauses: the body-group (ControlHeading/Detail/ControlFooting, absolute) case takes no edition branch
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same FIRST DETAIL..FOOTING range check at 85 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the two legal bounds on detail groups (g85_f01_04); no refusal, no control heading or control footing

probes.printed: COBOL2284 integer-1 9 shall lie between the FIRST DETAIL integer 10 and the FOOTING integer 15
COBOL2284 on a CONTROL HEADING NEXT GROUP 16; CFABS09: COBOL2284 on a CONTROL FOOTING NEXT GROUP 9 (each also COBOL0899 for the missing CONTROL clause)
probes.expected: refused for every body group type

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR5  (3.10.8 Body Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: The (ControlHeading or Detail or ControlFooting, absolute) case of BindNextGroupClauses refuses a value below FIRST DETAIL or above FOOTING and accepts both bounds. The diagnostic cites §2023:13.18.37.3 SR6b, which states the same range.
